description:
Make the docs describe the repo as it IS. Stale, dead and duplicated documentation is archived or corrected — never silently deleted.

MEASURED ON 2026-09-03: this repo is already clean on dead links, banners and directory structure. That makes this sweep about CONTENT — docs that parse and link fine while describing a tree that has moved.

DEPENDS ON THE CODE SWEEP, DELIBERATELY. Removing dead code changes what the docs should say, so documenting first means documenting twice.

THE STANDARD IS ALREADY WRITTEN AND IS NOT THIS TASKLIST'S TO INVENT: five root files, seven directories under `docs/` (`tutorials` `guides` `reference` `explanation` `decisions` `runbooks` `archive`), `docs/README.md` links every document, every file opens with a `Status · Updated · Owner` banner, and **nothing is deleted — it is archived** with a note saying what replaced it. Spec: `rosetta/docs/reference/documentation-standard.md`.

ROADMAPS ARE OUT OF SCOPE. `ROADMAP.md` and the roadmap plans under `docs/*/roadmap/` were reconciled portfolio-wide on 2026-09-02/03 and state their own evidence standard. Do not re-mark them here.

ARCHIVE, DO NOT DELETE. The standard says so and this portfolio has paid for the alternative: five consolidated strategy documents were unrecoverable except through one paragraph of prose. An archived doc with a note saying what replaced it costs nothing and answers the question a reader will actually have.

userStories.title: Every document is reachable, banner-stamped, and in the right place
userStories.notes: doc-integrity green (58 md files, 1462 relative links checked, 0 dead; all 3 status tables match headers); doc-links ratchet 0 dead vs 0 on main; .chief/verify.sh --run docs/README.md: all selected gates green. Measured before editing: 0 dead links, 19/19 docs files banner-stamped, 18/18 docs files already linked from docs/README.md — so US-1 was already met on ACs 1-3 and the real gap was AC4. Added to docs/README.md a DECLARED EXCEPTION for the six document-bearing directories outside docs/ (specs, scenarios, decisions, registry, schemas, policy) with the reason stated once, plus a table of the standard’s seven directories saying which koine has and why the other four are absent. Corrected the map’s own claim from “not linked here” to “not reachable from here”, since 38 markdown documents live outside docs/. Deliberately did NOT restate the ADR table (decisions/README.md stays its one home).
acceptanceCriteria: Dead internal links are repaired or the target is archived with a pointer. A link to a document that no longer exists is worse than no link: it asserts the document is current.

Every `docs/` file carries a `Status · Updated · Owner` banner. Where a doc is stale rather than current, the banner is where that gets SAID — `Status: Superseded` with what replaced it beats a silent edit.
`docs/README.md` links every document. Unlinked is unreachable, and unreachable documentation still greps as current — which is how a reader finds it and believes it.
Directories outside the standard's seven are either justified in writing as declared exceptions or their contents are moved. Do not move a directory other files cite without repointing them.
GATES: the repo's own verify green.

userStories.title: Content that describes a tree that moved
userStories.notes: verify green: guard-doc-integrity 59 markdown files / 1487 relative links checked, 0 dead, all 3 status tables match their spec headers; guard-doc-links 0 dead vs 0 on main; .chief/verify.sh --run over all 7 changed paths: all selected gates green. Read the docs against the tree and found SIX claims that were wrong while parsing, linking and resolving perfectly (both guards were green on every day each defect was live). C-1 layer-claim.md said 'two of the six are ratified, four are candidate' - true 2026-08-18, wrong from 08-20; today one (KGP 0.5.2). C-2 the capability-bus walkthrough's example AgentCard carried a top-level "url", the A2A v0.x shape KCB replaced with supported_interfaces[] at 0.4.2 on 2026-08-13. C-3 implementability-audit.md's receivable-set table said scenarios/ = 7 files (12) and decisions/ = 8 ADRs 0001+0005-0011 (11, 0005-0014); the other five rows re-count exactly. C-4 same file, IMP-16 said 'KCS 0.2.0 ratified and seven prose pressure tests' (0.3.0 candidate, twelve). C-5 README.md's layout table omitted scripts/ entirely. C-6 CLAUDE.md named 4 guards of 5 and 8 schemas of 9. Five of six are one defect - a restated fact whose home is elsewhere - so four fixes REMOVE the copy rather than refresh it (AC3). Every correction is dated in place in the portfolio's parenthetical house style plus a register of record, docs/reference/doc-drift-corrections.md, linked from docs/README.md (AC4). AC2: the 900 sweep removed 43 lines from scripts/check-doc-links.mjs only; `git grep -c 'EXCEPT_DIRS|linkignore|structure-exceptions' -- '*.md'` returns one file, the removal record itself, so no doc described removed code as live - checked, nothing to correct. Left alone and reported, not fixed: ROADMAP.md's 'That count is 0 of 6', out of scope by the tasklist's own instruction and stale since KGP's 2026-08-28 ratification. No normative surface touched - no specs/, schemas/, registry/ or policy/ file changed, no spec version moved, no clause moved.
acceptanceCriteria: Read the docs against the tree and correct what has drifted — paths, commands, module names, counts, and any claim the code no longer supports. This is the half a link-checker cannot do and the half that actually misleads.
Anything the code sweep removed is reflected here. A doc describing deleted code is the most confidently wrong kind.

Duplicated documentation — the same fact stated in two places that can disagree — is reduced to one home with the other pointing at it. Two copies of one fact is the same defect as two implementations of one behaviour.
Corrections are DATED and say what was wrong, in the house style used by this portfolio's corrections of record. A silently fixed doc teaches nobody why it drifted.
GATES: the repo's own verify green.

userStories.title: Archived, not deleted — and the record says why
userStories.notes: verify green on all 3 changed paths: guard-doc-integrity 59 markdown files / 1519 relative links checked, 0 dead, all 3 status tables match their spec headers; guard-doc-links 0 dead vs 0 on main; `.chief/verify.sh --run` reported "all selected gates green — allowing merge". AC1 — the sweep ARCHIVED NOTHING, and that is the finding rather than an omission. Supersession is not staleness, so the test (has something else become the answer to this document's question?) was applied class by class to all 60 tracked Markdown files: 10 normative contract surface, 12 decision records, 26 dated evidence, 7 living maps, 4 teaching, 1 process metadata (out of scope) — counts computed from `git ls-files`, not asserted. None superseded: all six planes live, every ADR reads Accepted (ADR-0005/0006's amendments say in as many words that they supersede nothing; ADR-0012 supersedes three spec CLAUSES, and a clause is not a document), and dated evidence cannot be superseded by construction — a later observation is a second record. `docs/archive/` therefore still does not exist, and NOTHING WAS DELETED: `git diff main...HEAD --diff-filter=D` is empty for the whole branch. AC2 — nine in-tree documents would fail a naive freshness test and three more are absent entirely; each is tabled with why it stays: the two fold-disposition pages (the reasoning the specs do not carry; federation-fold-dispositions is cited by four of the six specs, KINP alone five times, so moving it would be a spec edit), interop-trial and governance-taxonomy-map (dated measurements whose versions ARE the record), implementability-audit (counts corrected in US-2 because a count claims today; findings not touched because they claim 2026-08-18), the two dead-code registers (forward-looking documents written in the past tense), the two gate verifications (delete them and KGP's promotion rests on an assertion again), and ADR-0002/0003/0004 (relocated, not superseded; numbers permanently reserved). AC3 — four new limits stated: "nothing is superseded" is a judgement no guard computes; supersession from OUTSIDE this repo would not have been caught; banner accuracy was not re-verified (all 20 docs/ files read Status: Current and this pass asked only whether any had been REPLACED); and the archive mechanism is untested — the first archival will be the first use of the note format and of docs/README's archive row. Also found and fixed one new drift, C-7: dead-code-inventory.md's "prose (57 Markdown files)" was correct the morning the 900 sweep wrote it and wrong by that evening — armed by THIS tasklist's own additions (60 tracked / 59 outside .chief today). Fixed by REMOVING the count, the register's own doctrine; the guard transcripts further down keep their file counts because those are the record of a run on a date. The register's derived counts (six→seven, five of six→six of seven, four of six→five of seven) and docs/README.md's bullet were updated in the same edit so the fix did not itself drift. Evidence for the archive rule is this repo's own history, not assertion: ECOSYSTEM.md deleted 2026-07-31 (4ed42e1), needed 11 days later, NOT restored but rewritten (2e228c6) — 159 lines/8 sections vs 166/7, and `comm -12` over the two returns no line in common; the old §6 survives as one paragraph saying it was superseded. Honest qualification recorded: it was never unrecoverable (`git show 4ed42e1^:ECOSYSTEM.md` prints it), it stopped being REACHABLE. No normative surface touched — no specs/, schemas/, registry/ or policy/ file changed, no spec version moved, no clause moved. Files: docs/reference/doc-drift-corrections.md (retention sweep, C-7, extended limits), docs/reference/dead-code-inventory.md (C-7 fix + dated note), docs/README.md (archive row now cites the sweep).
acceptanceCriteria: Superseded documents move to `docs/archive/` with a note naming what replaced them and when. Nothing is deleted outright.
Report what was left alone and why — a doc that looks stale but is the record of a decision is not stale, it is history, and this portfolio keeps those deliberately.
State honestly what this sweep did NOT verify. Documentation correctness is not machine-checkable in general, and a claim that the docs are now true is stronger than the method supports.
GATES: the repo's own verify green.
